settings.generalDesc: Desktop general config, consumed by internal modules
settings.defaultThinkingLevelDesc: Default thinking level for the chat page, used when user hasn't manually selected one
settings.sidebarDefaultOpenDesc: Whether to expand the left sidebar on app startup, toggle with Cmd/Ctrl+B anytime
settings.showHiddenMessagesDesc: Show internal context injected by the agent (e.g. CLAUDE.md), off by default
settings.timelineCollapseDefaultDesc: Tool cards (Bash/Edit/Read/Grep/default) and thinking chain in session flow collapse by default, click to expand
settings.composerApplyTimingDesc: When changes to the model or thinking level are applied to the current session
settings.floatCardDesc: When dragging list items to reorder, lift the item as a floating card (filled background and shadow). When off, the item stays translucent in place while siblings make room. Affects all sortable lists (sessions, projects, plugins, etc.).
settings.debugModeDesc: Show debug tools (copy current render state) in the top-right of the session flow. Enabled by default in dev environments.
settings.reviewBasketVisibleCountDesc: Maximum number of comment chips shown above the composer at once; the rest scrolls
